captions.title: Tap the round + button
captions.line: It sits in the middle of the bar at the bottom.

captions.title: Search for the home
captions.line: Type part of its name, the estate or the area.

captions.title: Tap its photo card
captions.line: Check the photo, the area and the price first.

captions.title: Sold or rented
captions.line: Sold is already picked for a home that was for sale.

captions.title: What they paid in the end
captions.line: The final figure. Your 5% updates as you type.

captions.title: The buyer's name and phone
captions.line: The phone helps AV Homes confirm the sale.

captions.title: The day it was done
captions.line: It starts on today. Change it if it closed earlier.

captions.title: Next, then see what you could earn
captions.line: 5% of what they paid, once AV Homes approves it.

captions.title: Add the proof
captions.line: A bank alert, a receipt or the signed agreement.

captions.title: Send it in
captions.line: AV Homes checks the proof, usually in a day or two.

captions.title: It shows as Being checked
captions.line: Once it is approved, your share waits for pay day.
